sources.title: Release 6: Swiss public debt / GDP
sources.definition: Annual debt/GDP fractions. 1946–1987 uses HSSO U.45 total debts of Confederation, cantons and municipalities divided by JST nominal GDP; 1988–1989 uses the IMF WEO vintage compiled by JST. Excludes JST central-government-only history before 1946.
sources.revision_practice: Release 6 download vintage retrieved 2026-10-07; historical values and source splices may be revised in later releases. Retain this vintage.

sources.revision_practice: WEO histories and staff estimates can change between semiannual releases. DataMapper has one-decimal precision. The latest completed-year reading is retained as provisional.

sources.title: Gross domestic product, long time series (August 2026 vintage)
sources.definition: Annual Swiss gross domestic product at current prices, in CHF millions. FSO long-series CSV published 25 August 2026; select B1GQ/MCHF. The file also contains nominal and real annual percentage changes, which are not imported by this addition.
sources.revision_practice: Fixed 25 August 2026 publication vintage. Pre-1995 data are retropolated using growth rates from older accounting systems (OECD 1952, ESA 1979, ESA 1995); methodological consistency across the full history is not guaranteed. The CSV uses normal status A for all selected values; normal does not imply that later publication vintages cannot revise the history. New vintages require new immutable snapshots and a reviewed replacement import.

rights.conditions: Open use with source attribution, as specified by the dataset OPEN-BY link and FSO terms. Preserve the historical reconstruction caveat and statistical definition. These observations retain their source terms; the software MIT licence does not apply.

series.aggregation: Published 31 December population, not annual average or 1 January.

breaks.description: Census-based historical estimates give way to ESPOP annual population statistics.
STATPOP register-based population statistics replace ESPOP; population-definition and production changes around the 2010 census.

series.usage_notes: 1861–1980 census-based population estimates are reconstructed. 1981–2010 ESPOP; from 2011 STATPOP. Register-based census and permanent-resident definition changed around 2010/2011. Preserve these transitions; 2026 is absent. Counts may change in later vintages.

series.aggregation: Published annual percentage change; no derivation from nominal GDP.

breaks.description: Transition from reconstructed historical national accounts to the current framework; full history is not methodologically uniform.

series.usage_notes: 1949–1994 reconstructed historical accounts. The 1995 transition changes methodology. 1948 is explicitly missing in the source; 1946–1948 and 2026 have no value. Normal source status A is final in this retained vintage; later vintages can revise history.

series.title: ILO unemployment
series.definition: Quarterly total ILO unemployment rate in percent of the survey labour force, as published by FSO. Survey estimates are observed statistics.
series.aggregation: Published quarterly averages; Q2 only in 1991–2009. No interpolation for the missing historical quarters.

breaks.description: Diplomats and international officials were included through 2008; subsequent survey population differs.
Continuous quarterly SLFS replaces the historical annual Q2 survey. Revised weighting introduces a 2009/2010 boundary.
Changes to the SLFS survey in 2021 create a documented comparability boundary.

series.usage_notes: Preserve gaps before 2010. This is the ILO survey concept, distinct from registered unemployment. Final denotes this retained published vintage, not immunity from later revisions. Native quarterly data are available in the catalogue and downloads.

series.title: Consumer price index
series.definition: Published monthly total Swiss consumer price index, December 2025 = 100, basket structure 2025.
series.aggregation: Native monthly total index levels as published; no annualisation.
series.usage_notes: Available from December 1982 through September 2026. Historical levels are restated on the December 2025 base; do not splice older index bases. Preserve historical gaps. Annual inflation is a separate published measure. Final denotes this retained vintage and does not prohibit later revisions.

series.usage_notes: 1984–2025 complete-year published changes. Negative values and zero are valid. 2026 is incomplete and absent. History may change in subsequent vintages.

series.title: Nominal GDP
series.definition: Annual Swiss gross domestic product at current prices, in CHF millions. The FSO long series covers 1948–2025; 1948–1994 values are retropolated reconstructions. This measure preserves price changes as well as output changes.
series.aggregation: Calendar-year current-price GDP from the published FSO annual series; values remain in CHF millions without rounding.

breaks.description: End of the pre-1995 retropolated reconstruction based on older accounting systems. The publisher does not guarantee conceptual and methodological consistency over the whole long series.

series.usage_notes: Current prices; distinguish from chain-linked real GDP. Coverage is 1948–2025: 1946–1947 and 2026 have no observations. The 1948–1994 history is reconstructed. Source flag A (normal) maps to final for this publication vintage; later releases may revise it. Attribution required under FSO OPEN-BY.

series.title: Annual Confederation 10Y yield / historical proxy
series.definition: Annual OECD Swiss ten-year government benchmark yield from 1955, preceded by the SNB long-term Confederation yield-by-maturity proxy for 1946–1954. The proxy is an explicit historical extension, not a constant-maturity ten-year spot rate. 2026 is a partial-year average.
series.instrument: OECD ten-year government benchmark; historical Confederation bond proxy before 1955
series.maturity: 10 years from 1955; source-defined long term for 1946–1954
series.aggregation: 1946–1954: published SNB annual averages. 1955–2025: OECD annual benchmark observations. 2026: arithmetic mean of Jan–Aug OECD monthly observations (8 months), provisional partial year. Values retained at three decimals.

breaks.description: 1946–1954: historical long-term yield-by-maturity proxy; not an exact ten-year benchmark.
Switch from historical yield-by-maturity proxy to OECD ten-year government benchmark; definitions are not identical.
Partial-year average: Jan–Aug 2026 (8 months), not a full-year average or current yield.

series.usage_notes: 1946–1954 rows are marked reconstructed because of the proxy extension; their source yields are observed. 2026 is observed/provisional, not a forecast. This series differs from the daily SNB fitted spot-rate candidate. Do not pair the 2026 average with a different-month short-rate average. Data retain publisher-specific usage terms.

series.title: Annual three-month GMBF yield
series.definition: Annual average yield of three-month Confederation money market debt register claims (GMBF). SNB historical table 1980–2006, continued from monthly EG3M observations for 2007 onward. 2026 is partial-year.
series.aggregation: Unweighted average of month-end observations, using the last issue/auction in a month. Before 1990: yield at issue; since 1990: auction yield. Published annual values for 1980–2006; means of 12 EG3M observations for 2007–2025; Jan–Sep mean (9 months) for 2026. Three decimals.

breaks.description: Quotation changes from yield at issue to auction yield; last issue/auction of each month.
Continue historical published annual table with computed calendar-year means of the same SNB EG3M monthly series.
Partial-year average: Jan–Sep 2026 (9 months), not a full-year average or current yield.

series.usage_notes: No three-month observations are supplied before 1980; absence is not zero. 2026 is observed/provisional. Public SNB portal data are reused for non-commercial educational purposes with attribution; commercial reuse may require consent.

series.title: General government gross debt / GDP
series.definition: Swiss general government gross debt as a percentage of nominal GDP. Composite of JST/HSSO historical ratios for 1946–1987, JST-compiled IMF ratios for 1988–1989 and the April 2026 IMF WEO table for 1990–2026. The early aggregation and modern IMF liability/consolidation conventions differ; source changes are explicit. This is not the narrower Maastricht debt ratio.
series.institutional_coverage: Swiss general government; historical Confederation, cantons and municipalities, modern IMF general-government coverage
series.instrument: Gross government debt; historical and IMF definitions differ
series.aggregation: Annual gross debt stock divided by annual nominal GDP; 2026 is an IMF forecast
series.source_identifier: JST R6 CHE debtgdp (1946–1989); IMF WEO April 2026 GGXWDG_NGDP (1990–2026)

breaks.description: JST changes from HSSO U.45 total debt / historical GDP to IMF WEO public debt / GDP. Coverage, liability and consolidation conventions may differ; do not interpret the splice as a seamless constant-definition series.
Continue JST 1988–1989 IMF vintage with April 2026 WEO history. Source vintage and precision change; the two-year JST bridge is not revised with the current WEO data.

series.usage_notes: Not Maastricht debt and not Confederation-only debt. No pre-1946 total-government observations are imported from JST because earlier JST debt covers central government only. 1946–1987 is marked reconstructed; 2025 is observed/provisional and 2026 forecast/provisional (38.50% of GDP), not a completed observation. Historical ratios retain the supplied one-decimal rounding; modern ratios retain the cited two-decimal table. Historical data/adaptations: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with JST citation; modern data retain IMF and ecolod terms. Reuse this combined file for non-commercial purposes under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, retaining all source attributions.

series.title: Confederation 10Y − 3M spread
series.definition: Difference between matched completed-calendar-year Confederation ten-year benchmark and three-month GMBF annual-average yields, 1980–2025.
series.instrument: Ten-year government benchmark minus three-month GMBF
series.aggregation: Left annual yield minus right annual yield, in percentage points, after input values are rounded to three decimals. Matched completed years only; 2026 excluded because input averaging windows differ.

breaks.description: Quotation changes from yield at issue to auction yield; last issue/auction of each month.

series.usage_notes: Negative values indicate annual-average short yields above long yields; annual averages do not establish the duration of intrayear inversion. 2026 has no spread observation because Jan–Aug and Jan–Sep means are not comparable. Native source terms are inherited.
